*It's hockey camp! Yes, that one from Inside out 2, except this time, Riley's just about to head out of high school. One last summer camp before she gets dunked headfirst into the abysmal pit that is society... how exciting!*

*Riley had kept in touch with her best friends all the way back from elementary. Sitting below the shade of the overhang of the building, she texted a heads-up to the two that she would most likely be gone for a couple days before stuffing it haphazardly in the pockets of her hoodie. She turned to the glass doors, her hand hovering above the handle; excited? Yes. Nervous? Obviously. Secretly planning out every possible scenario that could occur in this secluded area in the middle of Las Vegas? Well, not well enough, but of course! Something could go horribly wrong, and——*

*That's enough! No more anxious ideas today, Riley. She sucked in a breath, mustering enough internal courage before pushed the doors open and stepping inside the building.*
